name: props_cubiceos_root_selection
source:
{ Cubic EOS root selection: liquid root, vapour root, and the neighbourhood of the
  critical point where the discriminant of the depressed cubic changes sign and the
  three-real-root branch collapses to one. Java realCubicRoots switches on disc > 0
  (one real root, cbrt form) vs disc <= 0 (trigonometric form), and z() then picks
  max(Z) above bB for vapour / min(Z) above bB for liquid. Right at Tc, Pc the two
  branches must agree with the oracle bit-for-bit in the branch TAKEN, not just the
  value. CO2: Tc = 304.13 K, Pc = 7377300 Pa. }

{ --- well inside the two-phase region: three distinct real roots --- }
zl_co2_sub   = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 250, 1.5e6, 'liquid')
zv_co2_sub   = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 250, 1.5e6, 'vapor')
zl_co2_srk   = eos_z('co2', 'SRK', 250, 1.5e6, 'liquid')
zv_co2_srk   = eos_z('co2', 'SRK', 250, 1.5e6, 'vapor')
zl_h2o       = eos_z('water', 'PR', 400, 2e5, 'liquid')
zv_h2o       = eos_z('water', 'PR', 400, 2e5, 'vapor')
zl_nh3       = eos_z('ammonia', 'SRK', 300, 5e5, 'liquid')
zv_nh3       = eos_z('ammonia', 'SRK', 300, 5e5, 'vapor')
zl_c3h8      = eos_z('propane', 'PR', 300, 5e5, 'liquid')
zv_c3h8      = eos_z('propane', 'PR', 300, 5e5, 'vapor')

{ --- marching up to the critical point along the critical isobar --- }
z_co2_290   = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 290, 7377300, 'vapor')
z_co2_300   = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 300, 7377300, 'vapor')
z_co2_304   = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 304, 7377300, 'vapor')
z_co2_30413 = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 304.13, 7377300, 'vapor')
z_co2_3042  = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 304.2, 7377300, 'vapor')
z_co2_305   = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 305, 7377300, 'vapor')
z_co2_310   = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 310, 7377300, 'vapor')
zl_co2_290  = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 290, 7377300, 'liquid')
zl_co2_304  = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 304, 7377300, 'liquid')
zl_co2_3041 = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 304.13, 7377300, 'liquid')
zl_co2_305  = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 305, 7377300, 'liquid')

{ --- exactly at (Tc, Pc): PR gives Zc = 0.3074, SRK 1/3 --- }
z_crit_pr   = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 304.13, 7377300, 'vapor')
z_crit_srk  = eos_z('co2', 'SRK', 304.13, 7377300, 'vapor')
z_crit_pr_l = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 304.13, 7377300, 'liquid')
z_crit_srk_l = eos_z('co2', 'SRK', 304.13, 7377300, 'liquid')
z_crit_h2o  = eos_z('water', 'PR', 647.096, 22064000, 'vapor')
z_crit_n2   = eos_z('nitrogen', 'PR', 126.19, 3395800, 'vapor')

{ --- supercritical: single real root, both phase words must give the same number }
z_sc_v      = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 400, 2e7, 'vapor')
z_sc_l      = eos_z('co2', 'PR', 400, 2e7, 'liquid')
z_sc_v2     = eos_z('co2', 'SRK', 500, 5e7, 'vapor')
z_sc_l2     = eos_z('co2', 'SRK', 500, 5e7, 'liquid')

{ --- ideal-gas limit: Z -> 1 --- }
z_ideal     = eos_z('nitrogen', 'PR', 1000, 1, 'vapor')
z_ideal_srk = eos_z('nitrogen', 'SRK', 1000, 1, 'vapor')

{ --- derived properties on both roots --- }
v_liq       = eos_volume('co2', 'PR', 250, 1.5e6, 'liquid')
v_vap       = eos_volume('co2', 'PR', 250, 1.5e6, 'vapor')
rho_liq     = eos_density('co2', 'PR', 250, 1.5e6, 'liquid')
rho_vap     = eos_density('co2', 'PR', 250, 1.5e6, 'vapor')
h_liq       = eos_enthalpy('co2', 'PR', 250, 1.5e6, 'liquid')
h_vap       = eos_enthalpy('co2', 'PR', 250, 1.5e6, 'vapor')
s_liq       = eos_entropy('co2', 'PR', 250, 1.5e6, 'liquid')
s_vap       = eos_entropy('co2', 'PR', 250, 1.5e6, 'vapor')
h_crit      = eos_enthalpy('co2', 'PR', 304.13, 7377300, 'vapor')
s_crit      = eos_entropy('co2', 'PR', 304.13, 7377300, 'vapor')

{ --- pressure from molar volume, both branches --- }
p_from_vl   = eos_pressure('co2', 'PR', 250, 5e-5)
p_from_vv   = eos_pressure('co2', 'PR', 250, 1.2e-3)
p_from_vmid = eos_pressure('co2', 'PR', 250, 2e-4)

{ --- saturation pressure: successive substitution, up against Tc --- }
psat_co2_250 = eos_psat('co2', 'PR', 250)
psat_co2_300 = eos_psat('co2', 'PR', 300)
psat_co2_304 = eos_psat('co2', 'PR', 304)
psat_co2_30412 = eos_psat('co2', 'PR', 304.12)
psat_h2o_373 = eos_psat('water', 'PR', 373.15)
psat_h2o_600 = eos_psat('water', 'PR', 600)
psat_h2o_647 = eos_psat('water', 'PR', 647.09)
psat_n2_100  = eos_psat('nitrogen', 'PR', 100)
psat_n2_126  = eos_psat('nitrogen', 'SRK', 126.18)
psat_nh3_400 = eos_psat('ammonia', 'SRK', 400)
psat_but_420 = eos_psat('nbutane', 'PR', 420)
psat_low     = eos_psat('water', 'PR', 280)
